justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces carry reduced, schematic anthropomorphic imagery together with small round elements (a pecked disc on the monolith, dotted clusters in the painted scene). Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a single vertical carved block with symmetrical, static low-relief motifs arranged hierarchically on one axis, while B is a flat, horizontally scattered painted composition of dozens of dynamic dark silhouettes in motion, with no ordering or framing in common.
